turns.instruction:
Analyze a 10 m simply supported beam with a left pin and right vertical roller. Material M1 applies over x=0 to 4 m and M2 over x=4 to 10 m; the section is B1 throughout. Apply 9 kN/m downward only from x=2 to 8 m and a downward 25 kN force at x=6 m. Use shared joints at the material interface and all load boundaries. Report Z displacement at x=4 and 6 m, both support reactions, bending moment on both sides of the point load, and the element-to-material assignment table.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
